payload.summary: Implemented and independently reviewed the revision-aware semantic index registry. Four blocking lifecycle and contract findings were fixed with regression tests; package, migration, schema, type, lint, OpenSpec, and architecture checks now pass, while live PostgreSQL cases remain environment-deferred.
completed_work: Implemented exact identity, leases, compare-and-swap promotion, and retryable garbage collection
Fixed four independent review findings with RED/GREEN evidence
Refreshed architecture artifacts and cleared structural findings

decisions.title: Preserve canonical validity from both sides of the pointer
decisions.rationale: Deferrable triggers on the repository pointer and referenced index prevent direct SQL from invalidating a promoted canonical main index.

decisions.title: Recover expired garbage-collection leases with idempotent deletion
decisions.rationale: A replacement collector can safely repeat storage deletion after crashes before or after the storage effect, then durably tombstone the registry row.

decisions.title: Separate pure registry models from persistence operations
decisions.rationale: The extraction preserves the public API while keeping both modules below the structural file-size limit.

next_steps: Create change-context, architecture-impact, and validation-report artifacts
Publish the branch and open a PR after GitHub CLI authentication and sync-point guards are available

relevant_files.description: additive registry schema and canonical constraint triggers
